settings.label: Where It All Began
settings.heading: A signboard, a bazaar, a beginning.
settings.body:
Mayaloka started with a single question: why does discovering jewellery have to feel like just another transaction? We wanted every piece to carry the same wonder as stumbling on a hidden stall in an old Indian bazaar — a little surprising, a little nostalgic, entirely worth keeping.

What began as a small collection of anti-tarnish pieces, inspired by the fading signboards and weathered arches of old marketplaces, has grown into a curated world where modern design meets the charm of discovery.

settings.label: The Inspiration
settings.heading: What sparked the journey
settings.quote: This brand, and every piece we design, is inspired by the idea that jewellery holds memory. It should feel personal, discovered — never mass-produced.

settings.label: How It All Began
settings.heading: About the Founder
settings.body: Mayaloka was founded with a simple belief — that the best jewellery tells a story. What started as a personal search for pieces that felt meaningful, not mass-market, turned into a brand built on discovery, craftsmanship, and a deep respect for the bazaars and signboards of old India.
